view_type: derived two-neural-branch view of archived results
selection: All sources and trials within each named experiment retained; only branch fields are projected.

record.purpose: frozen stress test of the prospectively confirmed FMM-aligned MoE under additive noise and missing receivers
record.limitations: This is a perturbation stress test of the same eight prospective source positions, velocity model, source mechanism, receiver geometry, and FD solver. The perturbations were specified after the clean confirmation, so the results test robustness but are not a second independent confirmation.

record.purpose: frozen stress test of FMM-aligned MoE localization under uniform inversion-velocity bias
record.limitations: The experiment applies a spatially uniform multiplicative velocity bias to the same Overthrust model and eight clean prospective events. It measures bulk calibration sensitivity, not transfer to independent geology, local structural error, anisotropy, attenuation, or field data.

record.interpretation: Zero-shot transfer audit only; no retraining and no claim of cross-geology generalization.
record.limitations: The Overthrust-trained waveform surrogate is evaluated on a distinct synthetic geology; the FMM fields use the independent model, while picker bias and search settings remain frozen from Overthrust development.
